title: 1. Broadcast Home
subtitle: Every campaign in one place
narration: The Broadcasts page lists every campaign in your workspace, with its latest delivery totals.

title: 2. Find a broadcast
subtitle: Search and filters
narration: Type a name in "Search broadcasts", or narrow the list by number, "All sources", or "All statuses".

title: 3. Refresh the totals
subtitle: Get the latest numbers
narration: Select "Refresh" when a recent campaign is still processing or its delivery totals have changed.

title: 4. Read the campaign row
subtitle: Total · Sent · Delivered · Read · Failed
narration: Each row shows the recipients as Total, Sent, Delivered, Read, and Failed, with date and status.

title: 5. Open the analytics
subtitle: Recipient-level details
narration: Select "View Analytics" on any row — and that's it, your campaign details are one click away.
